newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDES sets power firm privatisation for Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: BNDES sets power firm privatisation for Feb 28.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) will offer its 100 percent voting stake in power utility firm Dynamis Energetica at a privatization auction on Feb 28, the bank said in a published statement.
BNDES will sell a total of 295,525 common shares of Dynamis Energetica, also known as Nacional Energetica, at an auction at the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange at 1400 local/1600 gmt.
The minimum price has not been set yet but BNDES is expected to announce it by Feb 6, the statement said.
